notes: Part of the same 8-property Offbeat document - see offbeat-mara-camp-2026.json for sibling properties.
Has a Luxury Suite category (up to 4 pax) in addition to standard sharing rates - unique among the Offbeat Mara North properties.
Wholesale rate confirmed arithmetically as Rack x 0.70 (e.g. Green adult: $497 = $710 x 0.70).
luxurySuiteNote: Any additional person beyond capacity charged at the standard sharing rate applies.
specials: Family Discount, Honeymoon Discount, Per Single rate, 4 nights for price of 3, 6 nights for price of 5 (paired with Ekorian) - same structure as Offbeat Mara Camp, see that file for full wording.
includes: Exclusive use of vehicle for game drives (NEW from 2025)
Visits to Koiyaki Guiding School/Aitong School
excludes: Exclusive use of customised photographic vehicle: US$375/vehicle/day
Visit to a Masai village: US$30/adult, US$15/child
Maasai Mara National Reserve fees additional: Jan-Jun US$100/adult, US$50/child/day; Jul-Dec US$200/adult, US$50/child/day
Vehicle transfers in/out of Mara North Conservancy (rates on request)

policies.deposit: 20% deposit confirms booking; balance due 45 days prior to arrival.
policies.cancellation: >120 days: 20% deposit refunded (net of bank charges); 120-46 days: 20% deposit forfeited; 45-30 days: 50% of full booking value forfeited; <30 days or no-show: 100% forfeited.
